tei:div.tei:p: ༄༅/ /gsol 'debs smon lam gyi rim pa dad pa'i chu skyes bzhad pa bzhugs so//

gangs ri nas rin po cher gnang ba/ chos kyi sku yi bdag nyid bai ḍūrya yi mdog /yan lag bdun dang ldan pa bla ma rdo rje 'chang*// mtshan dpe'i dra ba yang dag rdzogs la gsol ba 'debs// bstan dang bstan 'dzin mtha' ru rgyas par byin gyis rlobs// bka' bzhi brgyud pa'i byin rlabs mchog dang ldan pa'i dpal// til rdung tshul 'dzin 'gyur med bde chen rdo rje'i zhabs// sangs rgyas kun 'dus bla ma mkhyen brtse'i mnga' bdag can| |gsol ba 'debs so thugs rje'i smin grol bstsal du gsol// he ru ka yi rjes bzung lung bstan mchog kyang thob// paṇa grub du ma'i nang nas mngon mtho byang sgo'i rgol ngan slog /srog bsdos dka' spyad mthar phyin bla ma mchog brnyes mdzad// dzñā na siddhi'i byin rlabs dngos grub bstsal du gsol// gsang sngags mchog gi chos kyi mdzod 'dzin sngags 'chang che// mos rtsol du mas rgyal ba'i bstan pa rgyas par mdzad// thar pa mchog gi lam ston chos kyi blo gros zhabs// rtse gcig gus pas gsol 'debs bu la byin gyis rlobs// gangs can ljongs 'dir 'jam dpal skyes bu'i tshul// bka' bzhin bsgrubs dang sgrub la brtson pa'i snying stobs can// khengs grags bskyungs nas nyams dbyangs skyug pa phyogs bcur 'thor| |bzhad pa rdo rjes byin rlobs khyod bzhin bdag kyang mdzod// de ltar bstan dang gdul bya'i don slad du// bsam bzhin sprul pa zla 'od gzhon nu sogs| |rdo rje rgyal po ratna shrī la// gsol ba 'debs so mos ldan byin gyis rlobs// bsod nams grags dang rdo rje grags pa zung*// rin chen seṅge spyan snga mtshams bcad zhabs// rin chen rdo rje rdo rje rgyal po la// gsol ba 'debs so mos ldan byin gyis rlobs// 'dzam gling chos kyi rgyal po dang*| |don grub rgyal po bdag po wang*// rin chen dpal bzang rin chen chos rgyal dpal// gsol ba 'debs so mos ldan byin gyis rlobs// mnyam med rin chen chos kyi rgyal po mchog

/chos kyi rgyal po kun dga' ratna'i zhabs// pad 'byung gnyis pa sna tshogs rang grol sogs// 'khrul med brgyud pas mos ldan byin gyis rlobs// dus ngan snyigs ma'i 'gro 'dul thugs rje can// dran pa tsam gyis sdug bsngal kun 'joms pa// chos kyi rgyal po chos rgyal phun tshogs kyis// tshe rabs kun tu rjes su 'dzin gyur cig /bkra shis phun tshogs grags pa rgyal mtshan sogs| |bka' brgyud bstan dang rgyal ba 'bri gung pa'i// bstan 'dzin skyes bu yi dam chos skyong mthus// legs smon btab pa chos bzhin 'grub gyur cig |de ltar mi phyed snying nas gsol btab mthus// chos sku mkha' khyab ting 'dzin mngon gyur nas// gzugs sku mtha' yas sems can smin byed shog /skye kun theg chen chos sgra sgrog par shog /gang gis bdag ming thos dang dran pa yi// 'brel bar gyur dang ma gyur gtsor byas te// nam mkha'i pha mthar gnas pa'i 'gro ba yang*// skad cig nyid la bdag gis 'dren byed shog |bdud dang mu stegs log par lta ba dang*// 'dre srin la sogs dregs pa can rnams kyang*// gang de'i bdag mthong tsam gyis ma bu bzhin// gdug rtsub sems zhi bdag gi gdul byar shog |shu bhaṃ/ 'di ni thugs rje chen po'i rnam 'phrul mtshan ldan gangs ri pa'i dbon po ri'i buu chung snying po'i don la shin tu brtson pa/ rin po che don grub phun tshogs kyis gsol 'debs smon lam zhig dgos gsungs par/ shākya'i btsun pa 'bri gung pa dkon mchog phun tshogs rig 'dzin chos kyi grags pa phrin las rnam par rgyal ba'i sdes/ rang lo bcu bdun gyi steng lcags pho khyi'i lo zla ba dang po'i tshes bco brgyad kyi nyin rdzong gsar bkra shis tshugs nas byin pa dge// / ༈ /dge slong bzod pa rnam 'joms kyis zhus pa| brgyud pa'i bla ma sangs rgyas byang sems dang*// yi dam lha dang chos skyong bsten pa yis// bdag ni skye dang tshe rabs thams cad du// dpal ldan bla ma rje dang mi 'bral shog// /

༈ /'phrang bu chos mdzad la gnang ba/ sras bcas rgyal ba'i ngo bo nyid// dus gsum sgrib bral lham me mkhyen// rdo rje 'dzin pa sa yi bdag /dharma rā dzas bdag cag skyongs| |de yi thugs rje las byung ba// lha dang bla mas rjes su bzung*// yang snying chos kyi rig pa 'dzin// dharma kīrti'i thugs rjes zung*// gsol ba rtse gcig btab pa'i mthus// bdag cag tshe dang sgrub pa zung*// mnyam nas gdod ma'i mgon po mchog /mngon sum nyid du rtogs gyur nas// mos ldan rtsa ba'i bla ma'i drung*// 'bral med 'khor gyi thog ma ru// skyes nas ci gsung dang ldan dang*// 'gro don lhun gyis 'grub par shog /ces pa rig pa 'dzin pa dharma kīrtis sgrub pa snying por byed pa rgyal 'brel nas/ chos mdzad pa dang dge slong blo gros gnyis la byin pa bha wantu/// / ༈ /lha rtse rje btsun ma la gnang ba/ rgyal ba sras bcas bden pa'i byin rlabs dang*// drang srong rig 'dzin bden pa'i tshig dang ni// yi dam lha dang chos skyong srung ma'i mthus// chos rgyal dpal mo bsam don chos bzhin 'grub// tshe 'dir bar chad bdud bzhi kun bcom nas// yang dag rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas rin po che// 'gro la phan phyir gegs med myur grub ste// chos sku chen mo mngon du rtogs par shog /gzhan don 'grub pa'i legs smon rnam dag mthus// gzugs sku'i sprul pas zhing khams yongs bkang nas// gang 'dul thabs ston spyan ras gzigs mgon bzhin// bdag gi legs smon myur du 'grub gyur cig /ces 'bri gung pa'i gdung las shākya'i btsun pa rig 'dzin chos kyi grags pa phrin las rnam par rgyal ba'i sdes/ sgar chen bsam grub sgar du bzhugs thog /gtsang bsam grub rtse nas lcam chos rgyal dpal mos bskul bar bris pa dge// / ༈ /phyogs bcu'i rgyal sras byang chub sems dpa'i mthus// bdag cag 'khor ba'i rgya mtshor gnas pa la// dam chos 'dul ba'i rdzings na bzhag byas te// brtson 'grus chen po'i rlung gis rab bskyod de// bde chen dag pa'i gnas su phyin par shog

/ces 'bag phrug gis bskul ba la/ chos dbyings rol pa can gyi sgar nas bris pa shu bhaṃ/// / ༈ /na mo gu ra we/ dus gsum rgyal ba kun 'dus padma las// sgyu 'phrul rdo rje'i gar gyis rab 'khrungs shing*// 'gro kun nges don theg pas grol mdzad pa// mtsho skyes rdo rje'i zhabs la gsol ba 'debs// klu yi srid sgrub thub dbang gnyis pa ni// gangs can thub bstan bdag po 'bri gung pa// rin chen dpal zhes sa gsum grags ldan pa// 'jig rten mgon po'i zhabs la gsol ba 'debs// da lta mngon dga'i zhing du rgyal ba'i gtso// rgyal ba klong yangs byang sems 'bum gyis bskor// srid 'dir rig 'dzin kun gtso rdo rje 'dzin// sna tshogs rang grol zhabs la gsol ba 'debs// chos kun dbang phyug 'khor los sgyur ba'i rgyal// phun tshogs rigs rus chen po grub pa'i gtso// snyigs ma'i dus 'dir pad 'byung zhal skyin nyid// dharma rā dza'i zhabs la gsol ba 'debs// ma 'ongs skal bzang dgu pa'i mtshan dkar gang*// sa ra ha sogs paṇa grub mang por sprul// da lta sum ldan rdo rje 'dzin pa'i tshul// chos kyi grags pa'i zhabs la gsol ba 'debs// rtsa brgyud bla ma rang sems tha mi dad// bcos min mos gus mchog gis gsol btab tshe// 'thob bya thob byed med pa'i dngos grub mchog /gdod ma'i mgon po mngon du 'gyur bar shog /ces pa'ang ma byan lba bas ske 'khor/ sku gzugs tshad las 'das/ seng gdong ma dgyes pa'i lag cha thogs/ spyan zhar bas 'khor 'das thog zhar zhes sam ma byan gtsang chung gis bskul ngor/ 'bri gung pa shākya'i dge slong chos kyi grags pas/ me khyi nag pa zla ba'i tshes nyer gcig la rtse ba gzhis kar bris so/// / ༈ /sangs rgyas chos tshogs bcas la skyabs su mchi// 'gro kun sgrol slad byang chub mchog sems bskyed| |bdag nyid tha mal gnas pa'i mdun gyi mkhar// gyad dang seṅge pad zla nyi ma'i steng*// rgyal ba kun 'dus rtsa ba'i bla ma ni// sku mdog dkar dmar rdo rje'i skyil krung bzhugs// dge slong cha lugs bka' rtags sgom zhwa brjid// phyag g.yas rdo rje sa gnon g.yon dril bu// lte 'og mnyam bzhag 'od zer tshad med 'phro// sangs rgyas byang sems rtsa brgyud bla ma dang*// yi dam mkha' 'gro chos skyong tshogs kyis bskor// phyi nang gsang ba de bzhin nyid kyis mchod// mos blo sgo gsum dang bas bstod phyag 'tshal// dpal ldan bla ma rig pa 'dzin pa'i gtso// chos kyi grags pa phrin las rnam rgyal sde'i// zhabs la gsol 'debs dus kun thugs rjes gzigs// bdag sogs 'gro ba'i nyer 'tshe nad gdon bgegs// 'gal rkyen thams cad myur du zhi ba dang*// tshe dang bsod nams dpal 'byor rgyas bzhin du// bsam don ma lus myur du grub gyur nas// dpal ldan bla ma'i go 'phang myur thob shog

/dgyes bzhin 'khor rnams gtso bo la thim zhing*// gtso bo 'od kyi phung por rab zhu nas// bdag gi spyi bor thim pa'i sgo gsum gyi// sgrib sbyangs bla ma'i sku gsung thugs mchog dang*// bdag gi lus ngag yid gsum dbyer med gyur// chos kun mi dmigs rang babs gshis su bskyang*// dge bas rigs drug mkha' mnyam sems can rnams// gdod ma'i sangs rgyas sa la 'god phyir bsngo// zhes pa'ang khams skyo bla ma rin chen lhun grub kyis bskul ngor/ 'bri gung pa shākya'i dge slong chos kyi grags pas/ rtse ba gzhis ka sra brtan rdo rje'i gnas mchog tu bris pa'o/// / ༈ /rigs kun gtso bo drug pa rdo rje 'chang*| |dus gsum rgyal ba kun dngos padma 'byung*// rtsa ba'i bla ma chos kyi grags pa'i zhabs// gsol ba 'debs so byin gyis brlab tu gsol// rkang gnyis 'dren pa zla med shākya'i gtso| |bden gnyis chags bral zhi ba dam pa'i chos// bslab gsum mchog mnga' dge 'dun 'dus pa'i tshogs// gsol ba 'debs so byin gyis brlab tu gsol// dngos grub stsol mdzad yi dam zhi khro dang*// phrin las kun sgrub dpa' bo mkha' 'gro ma// bar gcod sel mdzad dam can srung ma la// gsol ba 'debs so byin gyis brlab tu gsol// de ltar gus pas mchog gi gsol btab mthus// bdag sogs mtha' yas mkha' khyab 'gro kun gyi// nad gdon bar gcod 'tshe ba rnams bral zhing*// tshe dang bsod nams dpal 'byor rgyas pa dang*// bsam pa'i don kun 'bad med 'grub par shog /tshe rabs sngon nas da lta'i mur thug bar// las ngan sdig sgrib nyes ltung gang bsags pa// 'phral dang yun gyi sgrib par mi 'gyur bar// byang zhing dag nas tshogs gnyis rab rdzogs te// rang gzhan don gnyis lhun gyis grub pa'i dpal// rnam kun mchog ldan chos kyi sku rtogs shing*// de yi rang snang rang rtsal sgyu 'phrul gar| |chu zla ji bzhin longs sprul mchog dman gyi/ */sprul pas 'gro kun sgrol la gegs med shog */ces pa'ang 'phyongs rgyas pa karma dge 'dun gyis bskul ngor/

dbur stod 'bri gung du son pa skyu ra'i rigs las shākya'i dge slong chos kyi grags pas/ rtse ba gzhis ka sra brtan rdo rje'i gnas mchog tu bris pa'o/// / ༈ /dus gsum sangs rgyas kun 'dus pa// padma 'byung gnas dga' chen po// gnam lcags me 'bar rje btsun rje// dharma rā dzas bdag cag skyongs// bkra shis grags pa'i rgyal mtshan zhabs// chos dbyings rang grol lha mi'i mgon// chos dbyings rol pa'i rnal 'byor che// gsol ba 'debs so thugs rjes skyongs// bdag ni skye ba thams cad du// mgon po rnams dang mi 'bral zhing*// 'khor gyi thog mar zhugs nas kyang*// bslab gsum mthar phyin rgyan ldan shog /srid gsum rgya mtshor byings pa yi// srid pa'i 'gro ba ma lus pa// thams cad bdag gis mgron du gnyer// srid pa'i mtsho las sgrol bar shog /ces shākya'i btsun pa dkon mchog ming gis/ rtogs ldan lho brag pa byang gnam mtshor tshe blos btang gis sgrub pa lhur len du 'gro bas/ yab sras khu dbon sku mched rnams la gsol 'debs smon lam zhig dgos zhes par/ sgar chen mkhar rtser bzhugs thog byin/// / ༈ /thub dbang rgyal sras byang sems nyan rang tshogs// yi dam mkha' 'gro chos skyong gter gyi lha// bdag sogs ma gyur mkha' mnyam 'gro ba rnams// 'od dpag med mgon rgyal ba myur 'grub shog /ces pa dge slong rin chen 'phel la byin/// / ༈ /rgyal ba sras bcas byin rlabs dang*// yi dam lha dang chos skyong mthus// bdag gi bar cad kun zhi ste// bsam pa thams cad 'grub pa dang*// rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas myur thob shog /dbu ma 'jam dbyangs snying por byin/// / ༈ /sa gzhi rin chen las grub gzhal yas khang*// pad nyi seng chen bsnol ba'i khri steng du// phyogs bcu'i rgyal ba sras bcas bzhugs su gsol// rab 'byams 'jig rten 'jam dbyangs snying por byin// sa gzhi rin chen las grub gzhal yas khang*// bkang ba'i mchod tshogs kyis// rgyal ba rgya mtsho'i tshogs rnams mnyes par 'bul// bdag sogs dge ba dri med gang mchis dges// gsang sngags myur lam zab mo thob nas kyang*// rdo rje 'chang dbang mngon du byed par shog

/de ma thob kyi skye ba thams cad du// dal 'byor phun sum tshogs pa mi yi lus// rigs mtho dbang po tshang zhing dad dang ldan// btsas ma thag tu rgyal ba'i bstan pa'i sgor// myur du zhugs nas chos kun nyams blangs shing*// bslab gsum dri med tshul bzhin bsrungs nas kyang*// rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas go 'phang thob gyur cig /bdag nyid 'chi ba'i dus byed gyur pa'i tshe// bar do'i 'jigs skrag sdug bsngal kun zhi ste// thar pa'i gnas su rtse dgas bgrod gyur cig /dmyal ba bco brgyad bde chen zhing du gyur// gshin rje'i skyes bu ston pa'i tshul byas te// mi sdug sgra kun chos kyi sgrar gyur te// rgyun mi 'chad pa'i chos 'khor bskor gyur nas// sems can thams cad sangs rgyas thob par shog /ces pa grub thob dbus smyon chen po'i dbon po bla ma gtsang mar bas bskul bar/ shākya'i btsun pa chos smra ba dkon mchog phun tshogs rig 'dzin chos kyi grags pa phrin las rnam par rgyal ba'i sdes/ blo mos rgyal gyi sgar thog tu sbyar ba mastu/// / ༈ /thub dbang byang sems tshogs kyi mthus// bdag sogs nad med tshe ring zhing*// bsam pa thams cad 'grub pa dang*// de steng rdo rje 'dzin pa'i sa// ma lus myur du 'grub par shog /ces pa bde chen pa sde pa karma bstan srung yum sras la kha rag gnas mdo nas byin/// / ༈ /phyogs bcu'i sangs rgyas byang sems mthu stobs dang*// yi dam lha tshogs bka' srung rgya mtsho'i mthus// karma dge 'phel bar chad kun zhi zhing*// bsam pa thams cad chos bzhin 'grub pa dang*// 'od dpag med mgon rgyal ba karma pa// yab sras brgyud par bcas pa ma lus pa'i// bstan dang mi 'bral rjes su zhugs nas kyang*// rdzogs sangs rgyas pa'i go 'phang myur thob shog /ces pa nyin byed gling nas dbon po dge 'phel gyis bskul bar byin/// / ༈ /rgyal ba sras bcas bden pa'i byin rlabs kyis// grags pa 'od zer nad med tshe ring zhing*// dbang phyug rdo rje chos kyi dbang phyug gi// bstan pa rin chen mchog dang mi 'bral zhing*// skye ba kun tu bla mas rjes bzung ste// mi bskyod rgyal ba'i go 'phang myur thob shog

/ces pa sprul sku grags pa 'od gsal gyis bskul bar/ 'bri gung pa dkon mchog gis za dam rdo rje gdan gyi gzim phug nas byin/// / ༈ /rdzogs sangs rgyas dang de sras gang bzhugs dang*// yi dam chos skyong rgya mtsho'i mthu stobs kyis// bdag gi bar chad ma lus zhi ba dang*// bsam pa thams cad yid bzhin grub nas kyang*// skye ba mi bgrang sku yi mgon po mchog /rdzogs sangs rgyas pa'i go 'phang 'grub par shog /ces phyag che pa bsod nams 'od dpal gyis dgos zhes par/ btsun pa dkon mchog gis sgar nas byin/// / ༈ /ye shes rtogs dka'i rdo rje'i ting 'dzin ni// smra bsam brjod med mtha' las 'das pa la// mi gnas chos sku'i ngang du ro gcig pa'i// lhan skyes bde ba chen po'i mtshan ma'i mdangs// 'gag med rig pa ye nas shar ba la// yan lag bdun ldan zung 'jug rdo rje 'chang*// ma skyes mi 'da' rang bzhin dbyings 'dir 'byung*// de yang rtogs na rang rig ma lags sam// ye shes gang gis ches phra ye shes te// bdag sogs gdul bya'i rtogs par shar nas kyang*// ming gzugs bral ba brjod bral kun tu bzang*// rig stong 'dzin med skye 'gag spang blang bral// shāka thub go 'phang tshe gcig mngon gyur shog /ces ras chung phug pa'i rtogs ldan karma chos rgyal la blo mos rgyal nas byin/// / ༈ |zung 'jug bde chen mkha' dbyings rol pa'i klong*// lag na rdo rje chos smra gar yang bsgyur// sems can gang dag nam mkha'i mtha' klas pa// rdzogs sangs rgyas sku 'grub pa'i smon lam shog /ces sgar chen blo mos rgyal du yod thog 'brug pa'i rtogs ldan ngag dbang chos 'byor la/ shākya'i btsun pa rig 'dzin dharma kīrtis byin/// / ༈ /bslab gsum rgyan ldan tshul khrims nor gyis phyug /thos pa'i mchog mnga' sngags kyi rnal 'byor che// rig 'dzin dharma kīrti zhes grags pa// chos smra'i btsun pa khyed la gsol ba 'debs// bdag gi bar chad mi mthun gnod pa'i phyogs| |'gal rkyen zhi zhing mthun rkyen ma lus kun// bsam pa'i don 'grub rdzogs sangs rgyas gyur cig

/ces dpon thar pa la byin/// / ༈ /'khor lo gsum gyi don rnams rab rtogs nas| |rang nyid 'dzin dang 'chad rtsod rtsom pa dang*// rtsod pa'i gnas la dbang gyur chos smra ba// rig 'dzin dharma kīrtir gsol ba 'debs// bdag ni skye dang tshe rabs thams cad du// chos tshul bya ba nam yang mi gtong zhing*// rgyal ba'i bstan pa kun tu rgyas bgyid pa// don gnyis mthar phyin shāka dbang myur 'grub shog /ces pa lcang gling chos sding nas/ dge slong kun dga' gzhon nus dgos zhes par| blo mos rgyal gyi dbus smyon gzim phug nas byin pa bha wantu/// / ༈ /rdo rje 'dzin pa gar gyi dbang*// rdo rje gdan bzhugs bdud bzhi bcom// zas gtsang sras po lha'i lhas// srid mtshor byings la gzigs su gsol// klu sgrub gnyis pa 'jig rten mgon// padma'i rnam 'phrul dharma'i mtshan// byin rlabs thugs rje ldan rnams kyis// snying gi mun smag dwangs par mdzod// de ltar rtse gcig gsol btab mthus// dal 'byor rnyed dka'i don rtogs nas// tshul ldan bshes gnyen bsten pa dang*// de gsung tshad mar 'dzin par shog /skye dang skye gnas thams cad du// dkar nag las kyi 'bras bu de// sha mong sul bzhin ma 'dres par// don bzang ngang gis 'phel bar shog /rigs drug 'khor bar gnas pa yi// ma gyur 'gro 'di bsgral bya'i phyir// bdag gis byang chub rlabs po che// thub pas mdzad bzhin spyod gyur cig /dkon mchog gsum gyi bden stobs dang*// mos ldan gsol 'debs bden tshig dang*// bdag gi lhag bsam rnam dag mthus// don gnyis mthar phyin lhun grub shog /ces shākya'i btsun pa dkon mchog ming gis/ gangs ri thod dkar ba'i dbon po thugs rje phun tshogs dang*/ bkra shis gshong pa nang so dgos pa gnyis kyis smon lam phyag bris shig dgos zhes par/ rang lo bco brgyad dus byin pa mastu/// /

༈ /sangs rgyas kun dngos slob dpon padma 'byung*// hūm̐ chen ka ra ratna drag po rtsal// snyigs dus 'dren mchog dharma rā dza'i zhabs// rig pa 'dzin pa chos kyi grags pa dang*// yi dam rgyal ba zhi khro rab 'byams tshogs// ma sring mkha' 'gro gnas yul kun gyi bdag /dam can srung mar bcas pa'i tshogs rnams la// rab gus gdung bas gsol ba btab pa'i mthus// gnas skabs tshe 'dir nad gdon bar gcod tshogs// 'gal rkyen mi dang mi min bsam sbyor ngan// mi mthun gnod pa'i phyogs kun rab zhi zhing*// tshe dang bsod nams dpal 'byor dbang phyug btsan// rigs rgyud la sogs bsam pa'i don thams cad// 'bad med myur ba nyid du 'grub pa dang*// rang gzhan don rab 'grub pa'i go 'phang mchog /gdod ma'i mgon po kun tu bzang po yi// sa mchog rdo rje'i khri la 'khod par shog /ces pa'ang ban grong sngags pa mchog grub rgyal pos bskul bar/ 'bri gung pa shākya'i dge slong thugs kyi rdo rjes/ gzhu stod gter sgrom brag dkar drag po'i gnas kyi zhol 'brong ngur sum mdo'i g.yab khang dben par mgyogs bris su byas pa dge legs 'phel bar gyur cig// / ༈ /dkon mchog rgya mtsho'i phrin las zla bral ba// phun tshogs srid zhi'i dbang phyug mchog dam pa// rig 'dzin chos kyi grags pa phrin las mchog /rnam par rgyal ba'i sde la gsol ba 'debs// padma badzra rtsal mchog rigs kyi gtso| |che mchog 'dus pa rtsal 'chang he ru kaḥ /padma tshe dbang 'chi med grub pa'i dpal// thugs kyi rdo rje'i zhabs la gsol ba 'debs// mi bskyod rdo rje dkyil 'khor gtso mchog dpal| |padmas mnga' gsol dbur smyon mtshan gyi grags// dkon mchog phun tshogs rgya mtsho dpal bzang po// dpal ldan bla ma'i zhabs la gsol ba 'debs// bdag sogs 'gro rnams deng nas byang chub bar// mi mthun gnod pa'i phyogs rnams kun zhi zhing*// bsam don dpal 'byor phun tshogs rab rgyas nas// don gnyis lhun grub rdo rje 'dzin thob shog

/ces pa gdang mdo rdor 'dzin tha ba kha pas bskul ngor/ 'bri gung pa shākya'i dge slong chos kyi grags pas/ mi 'gyur ti sgro'i gangs 'dabs 'brong ngur du bris pa'o/// / ༈ /gsang sdir la gnang ba/ rtsa gsum kun 'dus rdo rje slob dpon ni// dkyil 'khor kun gtso chos kyi grags pa zhes// srid dang zhi ba'i rgud pa kun sel ba// dpal ldan bla ma'i zhabs la gsol ba 'debs// gang gi skal bzang gdul bya'i snang ba'i ngor// ma bcos chos dbyings mkha' la sgyu ma'i gar// gang 'dul der ston rnam rol phrin las bdag /rtsa ba'i bla ma'i zhabs la gsol ba 'debs// bdag cag dkon mchog tshe brtan la sogs pa// gdul bya rnams kyis gsol ba btab pa'i mthus// mgon po khyod kyi 'khor gyi thog ma ru// gegs med son nas thub bstan sgor 'jug cing*// khyod kyis rjes bzung so byang rdo rje'i theg /lam gyi mchog rnams 'bad med nyams blangs nas// sgrib gnyis byang zhing don gnyis lhun grub pa'i// rdo rje 'chang dbang go 'phang mchog thob cing*// mkha' mnyam 'gro rnams ngan song las bsgral te// rnam dag sangs rgyas sa la 'god par shog /ces pa'ang dkon mchog tshe brtan gyis bskul ngor// 'bri gung pa shākya'i dge slong chos kyi grags pas/ dbur stod rtse ba gzhis ka sra brtan rdo rje'i gnas mchog tu mgyogs par bris pa'o/// / ༈ /dkon mchog rnam gsum gtan gyi skyabs gyur pa// phun tshogs srid zhi'i dpal gyur bla ma mchog /rdo rje slob dpon lha sngags 'khor lo'i gtso// gsol ba 'debs so ye shes spyan gyis gzigs// rig 'dzin dbang po chos kyi rgyal srid cher// dbang bsgyur grags pa phul byung phrin las kyis// bdud bzhi'i dpung las rnam par rgyal ba'i sder| |gsol ba 'debs so byin gyis brlab tu gsol// srid zhi mi bskyod rdo rje 'dzin rgyal po// rigs kyi bdag po khyab bdag gdod ma'i mgon// dpal ldan bla ma 'khor 'das kun gyi dpal| |gsol ba 'debs so byin gyis brlab tu gsol// padma 'byung gnas snyigs dus zhal skyin ni// badzra rtsal zhes gsang ba'i mtshan dkar can// gang 'dul der snang sgyu ma'i zlos gar mkhan// gsol ba 'debs so ye shes spyan gyis gzigs// che mchog khrag 'thung zhi khro ma lus pa// 'dus pa mchog ldan rim gnyis rtsal 'chang ba// snga 'gyur bstan pa'i srol 'byed dam pa der/

gsol ba 'debs so ye shes spyan gyis gzigs// bdag cag mos pas gsol ba btab pa'i mthus// gnas skabs mi mthun phyogs rnams rab zhi nas// mthar thug don gnyis lhun grub sku thob ste// mtha' yas 'gro rnams bdag gis sgrol bar shog /ces pa'ang mgar bstan pas bskul ngor/ 'bri gung pa shākya'i dge slong rgan po chos kyi grags pas/ sa byi zla ba drug pa'i dmar po'i rdzogs pa gsum la pho brang rtse ba gzhis kar mgyogs par bris pa'o/// /siddhi rastu// ༈ /chos sku mi 'gyur rgyal ba 'od dpag med// longs sku lnga ldan 'phags mchog spyan ras gzis// sprul pa'i sku mchog padma 'byung gnas zhabs// sku gsum bla ma rnams la gsol ba 'debs// rig pa 'dzin pa chos kyi 'khor los sgyur// grags pa phul byung phrin las gdul bya'i dpal// rnam par rgyal ba rtsa brgyud bla ma'i sde// dpal ldan bla ma'i zhabs la gsol ba 'debs// de ltar gsol ba btab pa'i byin rlabs kyis// tshe 'dir nad gdon bar chad kun zhi zhing*// tshe dpal 'byor rgyas bsam don 'grub pa dang*// phyi ma kun bzang go 'phang thob par shog /ces bla ma sku gsum dang*/ rang nyid la gsol 'debs dpon dbang rgyal gyis dgos gsungs par/ 'bri gung pa shākya'i dge slong chos kyi grags pas/ pho brang rtse ba gzhis kar bris pa'o/// / ༈ /rang lus yi dam lhar gsal mdun gyi mkhar// gyad dang seng chen pad zla nyi ma'i steng*// rigs kun khyab bdag rtsa ba'i bla ma dngos// chos kyi grags pa sprul sku'i cha lugs can// chos gos rnam gsum bka' rtags sgom zhwa mnabs// phyag gnyis chos 'khor zhabs zung rdor skyil bsnol// dgyes pa'i nyams can rtsa brgyud bla mas bskor| |oṃ āḥhūm̐/ phyogs dus rgyal ba sras bcas mchog gsum dang*// yi dam mkha' 'gro dam can srung ma'i tshogs// kun 'dus rgyal po rtsa ba'i bla ma mchog

/chos kyi grags pa'i zhabs la gsol ba 'debs// bdag cag mos ldan bu yis gsol btab tshe// khyod kyi thugs rjes 'od dkar rab spros pas// gnas skabs nyes brgya'i mun pa gtan bcom nas// tshe bsod dpal 'byor ma lus rab rgyas shing*// don gnyis lhun grub 'byung ba gshis sam babs// rdo rje'i slob dpon lha sngags kun dngos kyi// gnas bzhi'i 'od phreng bdag la thim ma thag |gnas skabs bzhi yi nyes sgrib bsregs byas nas// sku bzhi ye shes lnga yi sa bon btab// rigs gtso 'od kyi gong bur rang nyid la// thim pas rgyal kun ngo bo bla ma rje'i// rdo rje gsum dang bdag gi lus ngag yid// dbyer med don dam bden pa dus 'dir rtogs// dge bas 'gro kun sangs rgyas sa thob shog /ces pa'ang rang re'i chos sras kyi thu bo bla ma dkon mchog phrin las kyis bskul ngor/ shākya'i dge slong chos kyi grags pas/ dbur stod rtse ba gzhis kar bris pa/ bla ma rang dang nang chen pa mchod yon gnyis kar gsol 'debs smon lam 'di kas 'thus par sems pa yin no/// /maṅga laṃ// ༈ /ka dag spros bral ma'i snying kha chos dbyings can gyi rjes/ drag po'i phrin las sgrub pa'i gong der/ chos dbyings gdal khyab zhing khams su// snang bzhi mthar phyin pho brang na// rig 'dzin chos kyi grags pa la// bdag yid gdung bas gsol ba 'debs| |'ja' lus grub par byin gyis rlobs// zhes sbyar/// / ༈ /phyag chen gsol 'debs la// gnas lugs rang grol skye med chos sku las// ma bcos 'dzin bral longs spyod rdzogs pa'i sku// gang 'dul der ston chos kyi grags pa la// gsol ba 'debs so bdag rgyud byin gyis rlobs// zhes sbyar/// / ༈ /khams skyo nang sor dgong lo drug gi thog tu gnang ba/ na mo gu ru padma 'byung gnas dang*// rje btsun ratna'i mtshan can la// gsol ba 'debs so thugs rjes zung*// dngos grub ma lus bstsal du gsol// mtshungs med chos rgyal phun tshogs dang*| |'gran bral bkra shis phun tshogs zhabs// yongs rdzogs dkon mchog rin chen la// gsol ba 'debs so thugs rjes zung*// byin rlabs dngos grub bstsal du gsol// zhes pa 'di khyod rang khu dbon la gsol 'debs zhig dgos zhes par bya bral gyis bris pa'o/// /

༈ /sga pa dbon pos ming yig dang*/ gsol 'debs shig dgos zhes par/ chos sku rdo rje 'chang chen dang*// rje btsun tilli nā ro la// gsol ba 'debs so thugs rjes zung*// sems nyid chos skur rtogs par shog /rje btsun nā ros byin brlabs pa'i// skyes mchog sgra sgyur chen po dang*// bdag phyug mi la dwags po sogs// bka' brgyud bla ma'i tshogs rnams la// gsol ba 'debs so thugs rjes zung*// sems nyid rang ngo shes par shog /ha hā zhes sgrog mgon po dang*// hūm̐ hūm̐ zhes sgrog bya rog gdong*// phaṭa phaṭa ces sgrog seng gdong la// bcol lo gnyer ro mthu rtsal bskyed// dgra bgegs thams cad rdul du rlogs// bar chad kun las rgyal bar mdzod// bkra shis/ ming du dkon mchog rnam rgyal lo// tshes brgyad gza' skar bzang thog tu// bya bral dkon mchog ming 'dzin gyis// lhag bsam rnam par dag pas byin// dge 'dis khyod nyid rgyal gyur cig// / ༈ /mtshungs med dam pa dkon mchog rin chen gyis brang mgo nas bsdus nas/ khyod rang nga la rtsom bzang ngan gang byed kyang sho lo ka gcig da lta rang rtsoms gsungs par/ krong nge rin chen dung gi me tog 'dra// krong nges 'jig rten bde zhing dge bar byed// krong nges sangs rgyas bstan pa rab tu spel// dkon mchog rin chen zhabs la gsol ba 'debs// khyod rang la'ang sho lo ka gcig gyis gsungs par/ ldig ge rin chen gser gyi me tog 'dra// grags pas stong gsum ma lus 'gengs par byed// 'gro ba 'di dag dag pa'i sa la 'god// dkon mchog phun tshogs zhabs la gsol ba 'debs// ha ha zhes so/ 'di ni dgung lo drug gi skabs su sku sha che chung gi 'dra bcad du phul/// / ༈ /dgung lo bdun thog tu lcam skal ldan la gnang ba/ drin chen chos kyi rgyal por 'dud// dus ngan dus su skyes pa'i mi// mi khyed kyi thugs rjes bzung nas kyang*// ci bsam thog tu khel bar mdzod// nyid kyis mi mngon dbyings nas gzigs// 'jig rten dge zhing lo legs dang*// bstan pa dar zhing rgyas par mdzod// sems can sangs rgyas myur 'grub shog

/ces pa a ce skal ldan gyis gsol 'debs zhig gnang gsungs par bya bral gyis phul/// / ༈ /nang so khams skyo la gnang ba/ bla ma yi dam lha tshogs dkon mchog gsum// mkha' 'gro chos skyong dam can gter bdag sogs// bslu med skyabs mchog rnams la gsol btab mthus// dkon mchog bstan 'dzin dpal bzang zhes pa yi// nad gdon bar chad ma lus zhi ba dang*// rang don chos sku chen po mngon gyur nas// gzhan don gzugs skus 'gro rnams smin byed shog /ces pa 'di nad 'di las grol ba'i smon lam zhig dgos zhes pas byin/// / ༈ /sga pa dbon po la gnang ba/ dkon mchog rin chen rnams kyi bden pa dang*// bstan 'dzin skyes bu rnams kyi byin rlabs kyis// dkon mchog rnam rgyal 'di nas bzung nas ni// 'gro don dpag tu med pa 'byung gyur cig /skyabs kyi mchog gyur dkon mchog gsum po dang*| |yi dam lha dang mkha' 'gro chos skyong gis// tshe 'dir ci bsam 'grub pa'i skyes bur gyur// phyi mar sangs rgyas 'grub pa'i bshes gnyen shog /ces so/// / ༈ /dge 'dun mang ba zhig gis gsol 'debs zhus par/ dus gsum sangs rgyas gcig bsdus pa// khyab bdag chen po rdo rje 'chang*// tilli dang ni nā ro sogs// grub thob brgyud pa rnams la 'dud// rje btsun mar mi dwags po dang*// phag gru 'jig rten mgon po sogs// bka' brgyud rim par byon rnams la// 'gyur med dad pas gsol ba 'debs// pad 'byung gnam lcags me 'bar zhabs// rje btsun chos kyi rgyal po dang*// rgyal sras bkra shis phun tshogs la// sgo gsum gus pas gsol ba 'debs// skal bzang thar 'dod gtsug gi rgyan// dpal ldan zhwa dmar cod pan 'dzin// 'gran zla bral ba'i skyabs de la// snying nas dang bas gsol ba 'debs// yongs rdzogs dkon mchog rin chen dang*// bya bral dkon mchog phun tshogs sogs// 'khrul med brgyud pa'i bla ma la// mi phyed dad pas gsol ba 'debs// de ltar bla ma'i tshogs rnams la// gsol ba 'di ltar btab pa'i mthus// bdag gzhan 'gro ba ma lus pa// don gnyis mthar phyin lhun grub shog

|'di'ang 'jig rten mgon po'i bu chen gyi rgyud/ rigs rus dpal 'byor gyis mngon par mtho ba khams skyo nang so dang*/ bla ma sangs rgyas bkra shis/ dge slong phun tshogs dang*/ a bo rgyal dar sogs mang ba zhig gis bskul ba'i ngor/ rang lo brgyad kyi thog tu byin pa dge'o/// / ༈ /yang khams skyo la gnang ba/ na mo gu ru/ sangs rgyas bstan pa spel ba'i phyir// 'dren mchog chos kyi rgyal po la// gsol ba 'debs so thugs rjes zung*// bla ma'i bka' bzhin slob mas sgrubs// de la brten pa'i phan yon gyis// tshe dang bsod nams 'phel gyur cig /ces chos kyi rgyal po la gsol 'debs dgos zhes par byin/// / ༈ /stag tshang bla ma karma rnam spyod la gnang ba/ bla ma yi dam mkha' 'gro'i tshogs// 'di phyi'i skyabs gnas dam pa mdzod// tshe rabs kun tu rjes su 'dzin pa dang*// skye ba kun tu 'gro don byed par shog// / ༈ /dbon po bkra shis dar rgyas la gnang ba// phyogs bcu'i rgyal ba rnams kyi mthu stobs dang*// bslu med dkon mchog gsum gyi bden tshig gis// bkra shis dar rgyas bsam don yar ngo yi| |zla ltar sangs rgyas bstan pa spel bar shog// / ༈ /dge slong bzod pa la gnang ba/ shāka thub 'jig rten gsum mgon chos kyi rgyal// mkha' 'gro chos skyong rnams la gsol btab mthus| |bzod pa phun tshogs skye ba 'di nas bzung*// rang don mthar phyin gzhan don lhun grub shog// / ༈ /dge slong sbyin pa phun tshogs la gnang ba/ sangs rgyas rnams la phyag 'tshal lo// de bzhin chos dang dge 'dun la// bdag yid gdung bas gsol ba 'debs// sbyin pa phun tshogs 'di nas bzung*// don gnyis mthar phyin lhun grub shog// / ༈ /rgya ya ru la gnang ba/ phyogs bcu'i sangs rgyas rnams kyi byin rlabs dang*// lhag bsam rnam par dag pa'i phan yon gyis// phun tshogs skye ba 'di nas bzung nas su// rang gzhan don gnyis 'grub pa'i skyes bur gyur/// /

༈ /bkra shis tshe brtan la gnang ba/ phyogs bcu'i sangs rgyas byang sems dang*// chos kyi rgyal po la sogs pa'i// rtsa brgyud bla ma'i tshogs rnams la// gsol ba 'debs so thugs rjes zung*// mchod pa 'bul sogs skabs dang bstun/// / ༈ /bla ma phun tshogs bkra shis la gnang ba/ rgyal ba'i dbang po rje btsun ratna dang*// de yi gdung 'dzin chos kyi rgyal po'i zhabs// grags pa rgyal mtshan dkon mchog rin chen zung*// mtshungs med dkon mchog phun tshogs la sogs la// gsol ba 'debs so phyi mar sangs rgyas shog /yi dam lha dang mkha' 'gro chos skyong dang*// dam can gter bdag rnams kyi mthu rtsal gyis// bla ma bkra shis phun tshogs ming 'dzin gyi// gnas skabs tshe 'di'i bar chad zhi ba dang*// don gnyis mthar phyin chos sku mngon gyur shog /ces pa'o/// / ༈ /yab sras la gsol 'debs smon lam zhig dgos zhes par/ sems can kun gyi skyabs gcig pu// sngags 'chang chen po padma 'byung*// rig 'dzin sna tshogs rang grol zhabs// 'gran bral chos kyi rgyal po la// bdag yid gus pas gsol ba 'debs// sgo gsum gus pas phyag mchod 'bul// mi dge ma lus so sor bshags// dge de 'gro la bsngo bar bya// kye ma phyir mi ldog par mdzod// 'di lag dal du rang lo dgu'i dus su bris/// / ༈ /ra khyim 'tsho byed la/ bcom ldan sman gyi bla la phyag 'tshal lo// gso ba rig pa'i gnas rnams kun la ni// mkhas par sbyangs nas nad la bltas nas kyang*// myur du shes nas de las grol byed cing*// sangs rgyas sman blas rjes su 'dzin gyur cig// / ༈ /bla ma rin po che bstan pa la gnang ba/ oṃ āḥhūm̐/ dus gsum sangs rgyas rnams dang byang chub sems// de sras slob ma drang srong lhar bcas pa// mkha' 'gro chos skyong dam can gter bdag gis// chos bzhin btab pa'i smon lam 'grub gyur cig /bdag ni deng nas byang chub ma thob par// mi khom brgyad dang sdig pa yongs spangs shing*// dal 'byor mi lus rin chen thob nas ni// dam chos yid bzhin nor bu byed par shog

/de la brten pa'i mthu dang nus pa yis// bstan pa rin chen 'dzin cing spel ba dang*// ma lus 'gro ba sems can thams cad kyi// don rnams dpag med bdag gis 'grub par shog /'di ltar bsgrubs pa'i bsod nams gang mchis dang*// dkar phyogs dge la spyod pa'i 'bras bu yi// rin chen bstan pa bsod nams yar zla bzhin// gong du 'phel zhing rgyas pa'i bkra shis shog /'bri gung pa dkon mchog ming 'dzin gyis/ bla ma rin chen bstan pa la rang lo bcu'i thog tu byin pa'o/// / ༈ /gu ru phun tshogs la gnang ba/ sangs rgyas rnams kyi thugs rje dang*// de sras rnams kyi bden tshig gis// dkar phyogs dge ba'i las rnams ni// 'bad med shugs la 'grub par shog /gu ru padma'i byin rlabs kyis// gu ru phun tshogs deng nas bzung*// gu ru de nyid kyis bzung nas// gu ru'i bstan pa 'dzin byed shog /ces byang gnam mtshor lo gsum gyi dam bcas nas smon lam dgos zhes par byin/// / ༈ /yung thang nag gur ba la gnang ba/ bla ma yi dam lha tshogs dang*// dkon mchog gsum dang mkha' 'gro dang*// chos skyong dam can rnams kyis ni// bdag gi tshe dang bsod nams spel// phyi ma yang dag sangs rgyas shog /shu bhaṃ/ nag gur ba karma don ldan gyis dgos zhus par byin/// / ༈ /zur mang rab 'byams pa la gnang ba/ 'jam dpal dbyangs ltar rab mkhas shing*// spyan ras gzigs ltar gting jo bzang*// phyag rdor ltar du gtum tshul ldan// 'jam dbyangs spyan gzigs phyag rdor gsum// 'dzom par 'dod pa'i rab 'byams khyod// bka' brgyud bstan pa 'dzin par shog /sems can kun gyi mgon byed shog /tshe 'dir sangs rgyas thob par shog /ces pa rab 'byams pa karma legs bzang gis smon lam phyag bris zhig dgos gsungs par/ bya bral rang lo bcu gcig gi 'go ru byin/// / ༈ /rtogs ldan har chung la gnang ba/ rgyal ba sras bcas 'dus pa'i ngo bo nyid// sangs rgyas kun gyi phrin las 'gro ba 'dul// 'dren mchog ratna shrī zhes nas bzung ste// rtsa ba'i bla ma'i bar brgyud mchog rnams la// mos gus gdung shugs drag pos gsol ba 'debs| |mchog thun dngos grub dam pa'i bka' drin stsol// 'di ltar snying nas gsol ba btab pa'i mthus// gnas skabs tshe 'di'i bar chad zhi ba dang*// phyi mar rdzogs pa'i byang chub thob nas kyang*// 'gro ba'i don la 'bad med lhun grub shog

/rtogs ldan chos rgyal mtshan gyis bskul bar byin/// / ༈ /bla ma shrī sidhas zhus pa/ rgyal sras slob mar bcas pa'i byang sems dang*// rig 'dzin rnams dang bden pa'i tshig grub pa// drang srong la sogs kun 'dus bla ma mchog /rig 'dzin chos kyi grags par gsol ba 'debs// de ltar gsol ba btab pa'i mthu yis ni// tshe rabs kun tu rjes su 'dzin pa dang*// mthar thug yang dag thub pa'i sku brnyes nas// 'gro ba'i don la dka' ba ma mchis pa// sems can thams cad bdag gis 'dren par shog /skye 'dir khyod la gsol ba btab pa'i 'bras// gnas skabs bar chad ngan dbang mi 'gro zhing*// yid la 'dod pa'i chos ni 'grub pa dang*// sa bcu'i dbang phyug go 'phang myur thob shog /ces pa sku mdun shrī sidhas rang nyid la gsol 'debs smon lam dgos zhes par/ rang lo bcu gnyis kyi thog tu byin pa dge'o/// / ༈ /nyin byed gling du karma chos rgyal la gnang ba/ karma chos rgyal tshe dang bkra shis 'phel// nad gdon bar chad ma lus zhi gyur cig /rang don chos sku mkha' khyab mngon gyur nas// gzhan don gzugs skus sems can phan byed shog// / ༈ /'jam dbyangs chos rgyal la gnang ba/ phyogs bcu'i rgyal ba thams cad 'dus pa yi// mtshungs med rgyal ba dbyangs can bzang po la// gsol ba btab pa'i mthu dang nus pa yis// 'jam dbyangs chos rgyal tshe 'dir sangs rgyas shog /smon lam dgos zhes par gdan sa mthil nas byin pa'o/// / ༈ /'phyongs rgyas su dpon sa rje btsun mar gnang ba/ dus gsum sangs rgyas rnams kyi mthu stobs dang*// drang srong dri ma med pa'i bden tshig gis// rig 'dzin dpal mo'i bar chad kun zhi nas// bsam pa thams cad chos bzhin 'grub pa dang*// tshe 'di nyid la mngon par byang chub nas// rnam pa kun mkhyen sangs rgyas thob par shog /bsam yas kyi sa'i cha sa phug theg mchog rtser/ bdun phrag gsum gyi bcad rgya'i khog tu lcam rig 'dzin dpal mos smon lam dgos zhes par/

rang lo bcu gsum gyi thog tu byin/// / ༈ /bla ma lha dang mkha' 'gro chos srung bcas// sangs rgyas chos tshogs bden pa'i byin rlabs kyis// tshe dang ldan pa dkon mchog tshe ring gi// gnas skabs nad gdon bar gcod mi mthun rkyen// thams cad zhi zhing med par nyid gyur cig /tshe dang bsod nams dpal 'byor dbang thang bcas// yar ngo'i ri bong 'dzin pa ltar 'phel zhing*// tshe rabs 'di nas byang chub ma thob bar// dpal ldan bla mas rjes su 'dzin pa dang*// dal 'byor mchog thob bstan pa'i sgor zhugs nas// sdom gsum rnam dag nyams su rab myong nas// rang gzhan don gnyis 'grub pa'i go 'phang mchog /rdo rje 'chang dbang sa la rab gnas shog |ces pa'ang dge slong rtsi shubs pa dkon mchog tshe ring gis bskul ngor/ 'bri gung pa dge slong chos kyi grags pas/ gdan sa chen po dpal gyi 'bri gung byang chub gling gi gtsug lag khang chen po'i thog kha gser khang du bris pa'o/// / ༈ /byang bdag zhabs drung bla ma'i sprul skur/ dus gsum rgyal ba kun 'dus padma 'byung*// zhi dang khro gar sgyur mdzad yi dam lha// legs nyes stangs 'dzin ma sring mkha' 'gro'i tshogs// bstan srung dam can rgya mtsho bcas pa'i mthus// blo bzang padma phrin las theg pa mchog /dbang gi rgyal po yongs 'du'i sde zhes par// 'gal rkyen nyer 'tshe'i dri mas mi gos shing*// bar gcod bdud kyi dpung las rab rgyal nas// mthun phyogs bzhed pa'i don kun lhun grub cing*// don gnyis bsgrub la zla bral theg pa'i mchog /'od gsal rdo rje snying po rdzogs pa che// 'dus ma byas pa'i sa la rab 'god pa'i// lam bzang rtag tu sgrub la brtson pa dang*// nam mkha'i khams mnyam 'gro ba ma lus pa// gdod ma'i mgon po kun tu bzang po yi// go 'phang stsol ba'i phrin las lhun grub shog |ces pa'o/// / ༈ /nor bu rgyan pa'i gsol 'debs/

dpal ldan mi pham chos kyi rgyal srid la// dbang phyug dam pa phrin las mkha' ltar khyab// bdud bzhi'i g.yul las rnam rgyal dpal bzang po// mtshungs med bla ma'i zhabs la gsol ba 'debs/// / ༈ /bla ma rin po che ba log pa'i gsol 'debs ni/ gang zhig sbyin pa la sogs tshogs gnyis las// legs 'khrungs phun tshogs srid dang zhi ba'i dpal// snang srid chos skur grol ba'i rdo rje 'dzin// dpal ldan 'dren pa'i gtso der gsol ba 'debs// zhes pa rnams kyang bla ma dkon mchog phrin las rnam rgyal gyis bskul ngor/ 'bri gung pa shākya'i dge slong chos kyi grags pas bris pa'o/// / ༈ /rig 'dzin sde snod chos kyi rgyal srid la// dbang sgyur grags pa ma smad 'khor lo'i mgon// phrin las rab dkar bdud bzhi'i g.yul ngo las// rnam par rgyal ba'i sde la gsol ba 'debs// gzod nas yongs grub lha sngags rten 'byung gi// sgyu 'phrul rdo rje'i gar gyis bstan 'gro la// phan bde'i dge legs stsol mdzad rdo rje 'dzin// chos kyi grags pa'i zhabs la gsol ba 'debs// stong nyid snying rje ro gcig byang chub sems// phyogs su ma chad 'gro kun la sman pa'i// snying stobs phrag pa'i khur gyis 'degs mdzad pa// chos kyi grags pa'i zhabs la gsol ba 'debs// bcas dang rang bzhin gcig pa gshis sam babs// rgyal bas legs gsungs khrims kyis rab 'tsho zhing*| |'gro la dge ba'i lam bzang ston mdzad pa// chos kyi grags pa'i zhabs la gsol ba 'debs// de ltar gsol ba btab pa'i mthu stobs kyis// bdag sogs dad pa ldan pa'i 'gro ba kun// mi mthun gnod pa'i rkyen las rab rgyal te// don gnyis lhun grub go 'phang mchog thob shog /ces pa'ang bla ma byang chub gling pas bskul ngor/ shākya'i dge slong rig 'dzin chos kyi grags pa phrin las rnam par rgyal pa'i sdes/ rtse ba gzhis kar bris so/// /

༈ /skyabs gsum kun 'dus chos kyi rgyal po ni// skal bzang 'gro la phan bde'i lam bzang po// ston mdzad grags pa mchog gi bla ma la// gsol ba 'debs so bdag la byin gyis rlobs// gnas skabs tshe 'dir nad gdon bar chad rkyen// mi mthun 'tshe ba'i phyogs rnams kun zhi zhing*// tshe bsod dpal 'byor dbyar mtsho ltar 'phel nas| |mthar thug rgyal ba mchog khyod byang chub kyi// snying po'i khri la 'khod tshe de dag gi// 'dus pa dang por skyes nas smin grol gyi// bdud rtsi dga' ston thog mar spyod par shog /ces pa'ang kong chung gis bskul ngor/ shākya'i dge slong chos kyi grags pas bris/// / ༈ /bla ma dang ni lhag pa'i lha// mchog gsum kun 'dus rdo rje 'dzin// chos kyi grags pa'i zhabs pad la// gus pa mchog gis gsol btab mthus// mi mthun phyogs kun zhi ba dang*// mthun rkyen yar ngo'i zla ltar 'phel// rang gzhan don kun 'grub par shog /ces pa'ang khams pa o rgyan gyis bskul ngor/ 'bri gung pa dge slong chos kyi grags pas bris so/// / ༈ /sman gyi bla dang drang srong zhang blon rje// rig pa grub pa rnams kyi bden pa'i ngag /ji bzhin bslu med de yi mthu stobs kyis// sman pa dkon mchog tshe brtan zhes 'bod pa'i// mi mthun phyogs zhi bsam don kun 'grub cing*// 'gro rnams ma rig las byung nyes gsum nad// gnas skabs 'tshe dang rgud pa kun sel zhing*| |mthar thug nyon mongs nad rtsa 'joms pa dang*// sman pa'i rgyal po'i go 'phang mchog thob shog /ces pa'ang 'bri gung pa shākya'i dge slong don gyi sman pa chos kyi grags pa zhes bya bas bris pa'o/// / ༈ /tshogs gnyis rta ljang shugs kyis rab drangs pa// 'gro blo'i yid mkhar 'gog pa med pa'i gar// rnam 'gyur skal bzang pad tshal la rol nas// dpal ldan bla ma'i zhabs la gsol ba 'debs| |dkon mchog kun 'dus rtsa ba'i bla ma khyod// phun tshogs srid zhi'i byed po mthar dbyung zhing*// dge legs lam bzang ston pa'i gnyen gcig pu// dpal ldan bla ma'i zhabs la gsol ba 'debs// rig 'dzin sde snod chos kyi nga ro'i sgra// grags pa ma smad phrin las phyogs kun tu// rnam par rgyal ba'i sde khyod gdod ma'i mgon// dpal ldan bla ma'i zhabs la gsol ba 'debs// phyi ltar 'dul mngon thub bstan rgyal mtshan 'dzin// nang ltar byang sems 'gro ba bu ltar brtse// gsang ba rim gnyis zung 'jug rdo rje 'dzin// dpal ldan bla ma'i zhabs la gsol ba 'debs// 'khor 'das dbyer med nges don phyag rgya che// gang shar chos sku'i rnam rol rdo rje'i gar// longs sprul gang 'dul der ston chu zla dngos// dpal ldan bla ma'i zhabs la gsol ba 'debs// bdag sogs mos ldan gdul byar gyur rnams kyis// rigs kun khyab bdag rdo rje 'chang dbang po// khyod las gzhan du med pa thag bcad nas// snying nas gus pas gsol ba btab pa'i tshe// 'di dang phyi ma'i bde mchog 'bad med du// rtsol ba gshis babs rgyu 'bras rten 'byung phyir// bdag sogs mtha' yas 'gro ba ma lus pa// tshe 'dir nad gdon nyer 'tshe bdud bzhi'i dpung*// rnam par bcom nas rigs brgya'i bdag po mchog

/rdo rje 'dzin pa'i sa mchog myur thob nas// 'gro kun 'dren pa'i phrin las 'grub par shog /ces pa'ang zhal ngo zug sa gnas kyis bskul ngor/ 'bri gung pa shākya'i dge slong rdo rje 'dzin pa rig 'dzin chos kyi grags pa phrin las rnam par rgyal ba'i sdes/ dbur stod 'bri gung gi pho brang sra brtan rdo rje'i gnas mchog tu bris pa'o/// / ༈ /phyogs bcu'i rgyal ba sras bcas byin rlabs dang*// drang srong rig 'dzin dmod pa'i bden tshig dang*// chos skyong srung ma rnams kyi mthu rtsal gyis// tshul khrims phun tshogs tshe 'dir nad med cing*// tshe ring bar chad kun las rab rgyal te// longs spyod dpal 'byor snyan grags bsam don kun// dbyar gyi mtsho ltar ches cher rgyas pa dang*// chos kyi bya ba phyogs kun khyab byas te// yan lag bdun ldan kun 'grub 'jig rten 'dir// sprul sku'i 'gro don 'dren pa'i dpal gyur cig /ces pa 'di jo phyag pas bskul bar/ shākya'i dge slong dharma kīrtis sbyar ba'o/// / ༈ /rgyal ba kun las lhag pa'i thugs rje can// rgyal sras bstan pa'i khur 'degs 'gro ba'i mgon// rgyal ba gnyis pa shākya mchog ldan zhes// rgyal bas bsngags 'os khyod kyi thugs rjes skyongs// sras bcas rgyal ba rnams kyi mthu stobs dang*// yi dam lha dang chos skyong bden pa dang*// chos dbyings rgyu 'bras bslu med byin rlabs kyis// bdag sogs mi mthun phyogs kun zhi ba dang*| |bsam don chos bzhin tshegs med 'grub gyur nas// rang byung rang ngo shes shing rtsal thon te// ka nas dag pa'i chos sku rtogs gyur nas// ma bcos ma sgrib gsal dang rnyog pa med| |lhun grub sgrib bral ngo bo stong pa nyid// rnam pa gsal la rang bzhin dwangs ma ste// gdod ma'i mgon po sgyu ma'i snang brnyan can// kun tu bzang po'i rol pa 'char bar shog /ces pa 'di bla ma stag tshang nas kun dga' rgya mtshos bskul ba las/

dpal shākya mchog ldan gyi rgyal tshab dam pa mkhan po byams pa chos kyi rgyal mtsho'i bka' drin las byung ba/ shākya'i dge slong chos smra ba dkon mchog ming gis nya chu glang dil du byin/// / ༈ /snying rje'i stobs kyis 'khor ba'i mtsho las sgrol// 'jam dbyangs ngag gi dbang po thugs rje can// blo gros med pa'i mun smag dwangs byas nas// shes rab 'dab stong rgyas mdzad khyed legs so| |dmar ser li khri'i mdog can 'gro ba'i mgon// 'jam dbyangs bla mas bdag gi mgon po mdzod// khyod kyi thugs rje tshad med las byung ba'i// gru rdzings chen po 'dod pa'i rlung bcas kyis| |bdag ni 'khor ba'i rgya mtsho las sgrol mdzod// nad gdon bar chad phyogs kun bsal byas nas// ci bsam don kun 'bad med 'grub pa dang*// don gnyis mthar phyin sku gsum lhun grub shog /ces pa 'di ngag dbang snying rjes dgos zer bar/ dpal shākya mchog ldan gyi zhabs 'bring*/ shākya'i dge slong dkon mchog ming gis gnam mtsho'i 'gram bkra shis do bo cher byin/// / ༈ /rgyal ba sras bcas bden pa'i byin rlabs dang*// zhi ba chags bral dam chos bden pa dang*// dge 'dun mi phyed 'dus pa'i smon lam mthus// bdag sogs tshe 'dir nad dang bar chad zhi// mi mthun phyogs kun myur du zhi nas kyang*// bsam don thams cad yid bzhin 'grub par mdzod// lha mi'i gtsug rgyan rgyal ba gser mdog can// shākya'i rigs 'khrungs zas gtsang rgyal po'i sras| go'u ta ma'i mtshan dpe ji lta ba// bdag sogs mos ldan kun gyis 'grub par shog /a jo bkra shis la gnang ba'o/// / ༈ /sras bcas rgyal ba'i thugs rje rmad byung dang*// yi dam lha srung dam can rgya mtsho'i mthus// bdag ni tshe 'dir nad med phun sum tshogs// 'dod dgu'i bsam don yid bzhin 'grub pa dang*// phyi ma 'od dpag med mgon phrin las pa// bde ba can kyi zhing du skyes gyur nas// don gnyis mthar phyin chos sku mngon gyur shog

/gnam ru pa mgon po la gnang ba'o/// / ༈ /mi mchog lha yi bla ma nyan rang tshogs// lha dang yi dam chos skyong dam can 'khor| |bden par smra ba drang srong rig tshig dbang*// rgyu 'bras tshogs bcas 'dus pa'i bden stobs kyis// tshe dang ldan pa dbang grags zhes bya ba// gnas skabs sgyu 'phrul lus kyi phung po la// nad gdon bgegs dang 'byung 'khrugs mi 'byung zhing*// yid la mi bde'i go skabs kyis dben nas// tshe dpal mnga' thang longs spyod 'byor pa'i tshogs// dper na dbyar dus dgung gi u da ka /de ltar ches cher rab tu rgyas rgyur cig /mthar thug sku lnga ye shes lhun grub pa'i// nges pa lnga ldan rdo rje 'chang dbang po'i// go 'phang mchog thob phrin las 'grub gyur cig |de ma thob kyi tshe rabs kun tu yang*// dal 'byor lus thob sdig dben chos 'byor zhing*// sdig grogs mi dge'i bshes kun rab spangs te// bla mas rjes bzung nor bdun gyis phyug pa'i| |'dren mchog kun gyi gtsug gi rgyan gyur cig /ces ra stag dpon dbang grags kyis smon lam dgos zhes par/ shākya'i dge slong chos smra ba dharma kīrtis ra stag rdzong du bris pa'o/// / ༈ /rgyal dang de sras rigs gsum lha yi tshogs// chos srung rgya mtsho'i tshogs dang bcas pa'i mthus// rnam rgyal dbang phyug ces bya gnas skabs su// mi mthun bar chad bdud tshogs las rgyal zhing*/ mthun rkyen dpal 'byor tshe dbang rgyas pa dang*// bsam pa'i don kun myur du 'grub gyur cig /mthar thug rang gzhan kun gyi don 'grub pa'i// tshogs gnyis myur du rdzogs pa'i go 'phang mchog /mtshan dpes brgyan pa'i sangs rgyas sku thob nas// phrin las rgyun mi 'chad pa'i dpal gyur cig /ces pa 'di dpon rnam rgyal dbang phyug la/ yul dbur stod kyi 'dul ba 'dzin pa dharma kīrtis ra stag rdzong du bris pa shu bhaṃ/// /

༈ /phyogs bcu'i zhing du bzhugs pa'i rdzogs sangs rgyas// de sras brtse ldan tshogs dang dam pa'i chos// rtsa brgyud bla ma yi dam zhi khro dang*// ma sring mkha' 'gro chos skyong srung ma'i tshogs// lha dang drang srong bden tshig grub rnams dang*// bslu med rgyu 'bras nges pa'i bden tshig gis// bla ma rin chen tshul khrims zhes bya ba'i// nad gdon bgegs dang tshe yi bar chad dang*// mi mthun gnod pa'i phyogs kun rab zhi zhing*// bstan dang 'gro la phan bde bsgrub pa la// nye bar 'tshe ba'i phyogs kun rnams bral nas// tshe dang bsod nams dpal 'byor 'khor snyan grags// mthun pa'i phyogs kun dbyar gyi mtsho ji bzhin// kun nas rab tu 'phel zhing rgyas pa dang*// bsam don ma lus gegs med rab grub nas// rdzogs pa'i byang chub dam pa myur thob shog /ces pa'ang bla ma ban grong ba'i sku skye rin chen tshul khrims kyis bskul ngor/ 'bri gung pa shākya'i dge slong chos kyi grags pas/ rtse ba gzhis kar bris pa swa sti pra dze bhyaḥ ༈ /dug gsum nad 'joms rgyal ba sman gyi bla// yi dam zhi khro mkha' 'gro dam can tshogs// lha mi'i drang srong rig pa grub rnams kyi// thugs rje rmad byung bden pa'i byin rlabs kyis// 'tsho byed mgon po skyabs kyi nad dang gdon// bar chad kun zhi tshe dpal rgyas pa dang*// 'gro gang nyes gsum nad la rab sman zhing*// bsam don gang yang 'bad med lhun grub nas// tshe rabs kun tu dpal ldan bla ma yi| |'khor gyi dang por skyes te chos 'grub cing*// sman bla'i rgyal po'i go 'phang myur thob shog /ces pa'ang tshe'i rig byed mkhan nā tha sha ra ṇas bskul ngor/ 'bri gung pa shākya'i dge slong dharma kīrtis 'bri klung rtse ba gzhis kar bris so/// / ༈ /'dren pa mchog gyur sangs rgyas sman gyi bla// zhi ba chags bral gso rig rgyud kyi mchog

/'dus pa dam pa drang srong sman pa'i tshogs// srung ma rtsal ldan rdo rje bdud 'dul che| |sman gyi srung ma mkha' 'gro dam can tshogs// lha mi'i drang srong brgyud pa'i tshogs rnams kyis// tshe dang ldan pa tshe dbang brtan pa la// dbang bskur byin rlobs bden pa'i mthu stsol la// gnas skabs nad gdon bar chad kun zhi zhing*// tshe bsod dpal 'byor snyan grags rgyas pa dang*// lus can nyes gsum zug rngus gtses rnams kyi// ya nga'i sdug bsngal ma lus rab bsal nas// lus sems bde mchog thob par rab bgyis nas// kun kyang dam pa'i lam la 'jug pa dang*// mthar thug spang rtogs mthar phyin rdzogs byang chub| |sman pa'i rgyal po'i go 'phang myur thob nas// 'gro kun sangs rgyas sa la 'dren par shog /ces pa'ang sman pa tshe dbang brtan pas bskul ngor/ 'bri gung pa don kyi sman pa shākya'i dge slong chos kyi grags pas/ 'bri klung rtse ba gzhis ka sra brtan rdo rje'i gnas mchog tu mgyogs par bris pa'o// //maṅga laṃ// ༈ /khams skyo dbon chung la gnang ba'i gsol 'debs smon lam bzhugs so// sngon dus 'phags pa'i yul chen por// sa ra ha dang chos kyi phreng*// chos rgyal mya ngan med la sogs// paṇa grub rgyal po ji snyed pas// bstan 'gror sman pa phul du phyin// da lta 'gru rgyal skyu ra yi// gdung las sum ldan rdo rje 'dzin// 'khor lo gnyis ldan smin lam gyi// lam bzang po la 'gro ba 'dren// ma 'ongs byang chub snying po ru// mngon 'tshang rgya tshe me tog ces// bskal bzang rgyal ba dgu pa ste// tshogs gnyis rta bdun gyis drangs pa'i// 'gro ba'i mun sel nyi ma mchog /rigs kun khyab bdag rdo rje 'dzin// rtsa ba'i bla ma'i mchog dam pa// chos kyi grags pa gang de la// gus pa mchog gis gsol ba 'debs| |gnas skabs mthar thug thams cad du// dam pa khyod kyis rjes bzung ste// 'bral med gus pas rtag mchod cing*// khyod dang skal pa mnyam par shog

/ces pa'ang mgon po 'bri gung pa chen po nas nye bar bzung*/ rang re'i chos sras kyi thu bo rim par son pa'i rigs/ khams skyo nang so bla ma dkon mchog rnam rgyal gyis bskul ngor/ 'bri gung pa chos kyi grags pas rang lo re gnyis par/ rtse ba gzhis ka sra brtan rdo rje'i gnas mchog tu sbyar ba'o/// / ༈ /rtsa brgyud bla ma'i byin rlabs dpal du 'bar// yi dam zhi khros dngos grub char du 'bebs// ma sring mkha' 'gros phrin las rnam bzhi sgrub// dam can srung mas bar gcod rtsad nas 'byin// bslu med rgyu 'bras bden gnyis zung du 'jug /rten cing 'brel byung gdod nas yongs su grub// chos kun gshis babs spros bral chos kyi sku// de ltar bden pa'i byin rlabs rmad byung mthus// bla ma dkon mchog rnam rgyal zhes bgyi ba'i// nad gdon bar gcod nye bar 'tshe ba kun// ming yang med pa zhi ba chen po nyid// tshe dang bsod nams dpal 'byor 'khor 'bangs sogs// dgos dgu lhun grub dar zhing rgyas pa dang*// sems can kun la phan pa mchog grub cing*// sgrub brgyud bstan pa'i rgyal mtshan rab bzung ste/ /rdo rje 'chang dbang myur du thob gyur cig /ces pa'ang khams skyo nang so dkon mchog rnam par rgyal bas bskul ngor/ 'bri gung pa shākya'i dge slong chos kyi grags pas rtse ba gzhis ka sra brtan rdo rje'i gnas mchog tu bris pa yin no// //sarba maṅga laṃ//
